title: Geometric Construction of the Resultant
body: Three displacement vectors $$\vec{A}$$, $$\vec{B}$$, $$and$$ $$\vec{C}$$ have magnitudes $$A=10.0$$ cm, $$B=7.0$$ cm, $$C=8.0$$ cm and direction angles $$\alpha=35\degree$$, $$\beta=-110\degree$$, $$\gamma=30\degree$$ from the horizontal. Find the following vector sums: (a) $$\vec{R}=\vec{A}+\vec{B}$$, $$(b)$$ $$\vec{D}=\vec{A}-\vec{B}$$, $$and$$ $$(c)$$ \vec{S}=\vec{A}-3\vec{B}+\vec{C}$$.\n##figure2.gif
